arcs.title: The Briefcase
arcs.summary: Day 2: The briefcase moved overnight from the Sub-Division Head's shelf into Senior Archivist Quoyne's locked office, settling on his blotter and glowing amber-gold. Quoyne is treating it as a filing irregularity. The Department of Mysteries declined to comment with an air of recognition. The shelf cooled; the blotter is warm. No one has tried the lock. Day 3 should escalate — perhaps the glow changes colour in the presence of a specific person who passes Quoyne's open door, or the briefcase is found to have a name tag that wasn't there before, or a third Ministry figure is drawn into proximity in a way that begins to suggest the briefcase is navigating toward something specific.
